title: Rapid onramp snippet visuals: auth, key rotation, streaming, tool-call tiles
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact, modular set of onboarding visuals for the API/SDK quickstart that illustrate: 1) authentication and API key creation/rotation, 2) streaming responses and connection lifecycle, and 3) function/tool calling patterns. Assets must be usable as inline docs illustrations, screenshot overlays, and small hero tiles for the Quickstart page. Deliverables: a Figma page with hi-fi frames, export-ready PNG/SVG slices at 1x/2x, a small CSS spec for tooltip overlays, and example annotated screenshots for the Console. Accessibility: include text alternatives and ensure color contrast meets AA. Avoid duplicating prior packs; this suite should be more modular and tile-based (small 320x180 tiles and 1280x720 hero variants).
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with separate pages for Auth, Streaming, ToolCalls, and Export
8 tile variants exported as PNG and SVG at 1x and 2x
Two annotated Console screenshots (auth flow + streaming session) with callouts matching copy in docs
Design tokens and color values added to the Figma file and a short CSS snippet included
UX review notes addressed and PM sign-off in comments
Files uploaded to the shared Drive folder and links included in ticket
